steps.title: Prepare 96‑well Armadillo plate
steps.instruction: Set up a 96‑well Armadillo plate (200 µL capacity) for the Cerillo Stratus; keep an "x" in the top‑left well and use "x" in any well where a volume should be omitted.

steps.title: Add buffer to deepwell plate
steps.instruction: If desired, add buffer to the deep‑well plate using a single‑channel pipette according to the buffer CSV file.

steps.title: Add stock to deepwell plate
steps.instruction: If desired, add stock to the deep‑well plate using a single‑channel pipette according to the stock CSV file.

steps.title: Mix stock and buffer, transfer
steps.instruction: Mix the added stock and buffer with a multi‑channel pipette, then transfer the resulting mixture to the Cerillo reader plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix stock and buffer with multi‑channel pipette

steps.title: Premix cells with multi‑channel
steps.instruction: Premix the cells using a multi‑channel pipette (volume as defined in the protocol).

steps.title: Transfer cells to reader
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL of the premixed cells to the reader plate; after each transfer, mix the well three times when using diluted stock.
